verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in, in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Skills, MCP and plugin integrations let external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) drive Cekura, so they are not a built-in assistant. Features like AI-generated mock tool data, auto-generated evaluators and metrics, and automatic fix suggestions are adjacent AI features, not a delegatable assistant inside the product.
